end.summary:
Dev showed understanding of radius, chord, diameter, arc, segment and sector, including why a diameter is the longest chord.
Dev practised relating diameter, radius and chords; this still needs checking in new examples.
Dev practised reflection and rotation symmetries; the idea that a circle has only 2 or 4 symmetry lines was still present at the last check.
Dev identified sector and segment definitions again near the end; teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised circle parts, the relationship between radius, diameter and chords, and reflection and rotation symmetry with Dev. Dev used the pizza-slice image to distinguish a sector from a segment and gave the reason that a diameter is the longest chord. The mix-up about a circle having only four lines of symmetry was not corrected by the last check. At home, ask Dev to test several different lines through a circle and count which ones leave both halves matching, then repeat with a small turn of the circle.
